title: [DEV] Status Line is not showing all information
symptom: The Statusline shows the date of the last reservoir change and the age of the battery, but not their values. On the Action Screen only parts of the value are shown. In landscape mode it works fine.
fix: Selecting 'Skin: Low resolution skin' in settings hides some labels, but not all. The issue was addressed in a commit by MilosKozak.
evidence_quote: If you select "Skin: Low resolution skin" in the settings, then the superfluous, space-eating labels like "Alter:" and "Abgegeben:" are hidden.
